A. GENERAL REGULATIONS 
 
1. INTRODUCTION 
The BINUS name is renowned  globally and the company has established itself as a 
reputable educational institution. It has progressed from its humble beginnings in the 
1970s as an Information Systems institution to now where we are achieving national 
accolades, awards, and prestige. 
The BINUS group has a distinguished history; one that has nurtured and inspired 
respectable and successful individuals to contribute and excel in the globalized world that 
we now live in. This commitment has enhanced the BINUS group immeasurably. 
This is yet another milestone in BINUS ’ history, with another exciting project : BINUS 
SQUARE – Hall of Residence. Due to an overwhelming demand for a BINUS – lifestyle 
accommodation from you, the students, we have listened and responded to your wishes. 
BINUS SQUARE strives to enrich our students with added value of much more than just a 
place to stay. A home away from home. 
Located in the Kemanggisan area of West Jakarta, on Jalan Budi Raya , BINUS SQUARE has 
four halls. Two halls are dedicated for female boarders and two halls are for male boarders 
which can accommodate 2 ,500 students. BINUS SQUARE ’s mission is to ensure that the 
personal care, recreational, academic, social , and safety needs of every student are fully 
catered for. We have a dedicated team of staff and lecturers that will reside in BINUS 
SQUARE to meet those needs. 
At BINUS SQUARE we say: “A vibrant and exciting university boarding life”; this is definitely 
the choice for your accommodation. Please look through this website for a tour of all the 
exciting facilities that are offered. We welcome you to be part of the BINUS SQUARE family. 
 
2. ROOM AND CONTRACT PROCEDURES 
 
BINUS Square Management has full authority in determining the allocation of room units 
for Boarders and Boarders should accept all decisions determined by Management. 
 
2.1. CHECK-IN PROCEDURES 
 
Boarders must check in at BINUS Square on the designated date and follow all the 
established procedures. Failure to do so will result in the termination of certain services at 
BINUS Square.

2.2. CHECK-OUT PROCEDURES 
 
2.2.1 CONTRACT PERIOD EXPIRES 
 
The check-out schedule for the contract period of 2025-2026 is a maximum of August 1-
8, 2026. Boarders who do not continue their contract period are required to vacate the 
premises according to the established schedule and procedures. Late vacating of the room 
will be subject to a fee of Rp120,000 per day. Room vacancy procedures: 
▪ Fill out the Boarder Exit Form 1 (one) month in advance online at the Boarder Portal / 
BINUS Square Mobile. 
▪ Make sure no personal items are left in the room. 
▪ The room will be handed back to BINUS Square Management in a neat and clean 
condition without any trash; otherwise, a cleaning fee of Rp250,000 will be charged. 
▪ Boarders must be present at the time of room handover. 
▪ Boarders should return the keys (main door, balcony door, and wardrobe) and Internet 
modem. 
▪ If damage is found to the room unit at the time of handover of the room, the Boarder is 
obliged to pay the repair and replacement costs (see point 8). 
 
2.2.2 BEFORE THE CONTRACT PERIOD ENDS 
 
▪ Boarders who wish to leave BINUS Square before the end of their contract period must 
report to the Marketing Department 1 (one) month in advance. 
▪ Boarders who leave without prior notice will be subject to sanctions. These sanctions 
may include the removal of items from the room and/or impact on  the student ’s 
academic activities. 
▪ Leaving/ Moving or returning the keys does not mean canceling the contract or releasing 
the Boarder from his/her obligations as written in the contract. 
▪ The deposit paid at the start of the contract is non-refundable; it cannot be used for any 
payments (fines, damages, etc.) and cannot be transferred to another Boarder. 
 
For a Double Room, if one of the Boarders decides to move/ leave the occupied room, then: 
▪ Management will allocate a new Boarder to replace the previous one or, 
▪ The remaining boarder will be asked to join with another boarder who is still alone or, 
▪ The Boarder can request to be moved to a single room, if available. The rental fee will 
be adjusted accordingly.

2.3. ROOM CHANGE 
 
Room change can only be made if the room conditions do not allow for occupancy or 
based on a Management policy. 
▪ If this room change results in additional rental costs and/or excess electricity usage, 
then the costs must be paid in full before the Boarder occupies the new room. 
▪ If there is an excess payment, the excess will be used as a deposit for the next payment 
period. 
▪ Before moving rooms, the Boarder will carry out a room inspection process and if any 
damage is found to the room, the Boarder will be charged for repair and replacement 
costs (see point 8). 
▪ Move room for the first and second time because of a personal reason (not because 
of a management request or policy) no charged cost. 
▪ Move room for a third time and so on  for a personal reason will be charged an 
administration fee of Rp500,000 per move. 
 
2.1. CONTRACT EXTENSION PROCEDURES 
 
▪ Boarders who wish to continue renting a room for the next period are required to fill 
out the re -registration/renewal form online on the Boarder Portal/ BINUS Square 
Mobile. 
▪ The Boarder is required to inform the plan for a contract extension to BINUS Square 
Management a minimum of 2 months before the contract period ends. 
▪ BINUS Square Management has the right to determine the terms and conditions for 
renewal, including but not limited to special notes from BINUS Square Management. 
 
 
3. CODE OF CONDUCT AND DISCIPLINARY ACTIONS 
 
▪ Boarders must behave politely and maintain the good name of BINUS Square and 
BINUS University. 
▪ Any violation of the rules and regulations will result in being expelled from BINUS 
Square and not being allowed to be in the BINUS Square area. 
▪ If a Boarder who is subject to sanctions is removed from BINUS Square, then all 
payments made will not be refunded. 
▪ All violations are recorded in a report book and signed by the Boarder. The Boarder ’s 
parents will be notified by phone or letter in accordance with the applicable 
regulations (see point 12). A copy of the letter should be sent to BINUS University if 
the student is removed from BINUS Square. 
▪ Sanctions will be adjusted based on the severity of the violation committed or the 
material or non-material losses incurred. 
▪ Violations that are not listed in this handbook will be subject to separate sanctions 
determined by Management and will be final.

3.1. VISITORS 
 
▪ Visitors are required to exchange their ID Card s (BINUSIAN card/KTP/SIM/PASSPORT) 
for a visitor card at the Front Office, accompanied by a Boarder, and show the visitor 
card to the security officer to enter the residence hall. 
▪ The maximum number of family visitors is 4 (four) people, including famil y members 
of different genders. This rule only applies if visitors come with their 
parents/guardians.  
▪ Visitors who will visit the room area must be of the same gender except parents/ 
designated guardians. The maximum number of visitors per Boarder is 2 (two) people. 
▪ Visiting hours are from 6:00 AM - 9:45 PM. Visitors are required to return their visitor 
cards to the Front Office. 
▪ Visitors are not permitted to stay in the Boarder rooms. 
▪ Late visitors/ Failure to return a visitor card after visiting hours will result in a fine (see 
point 8). Lost cards will be fined Rp110,000. Late card returns will incur a fine of 
Rp150,000 per day, payable to the Front Office. 
▪ Boarders are fully responsible for the visitors they bring, including their actions that 
can be categorized as violations. 
▪ Boarders who bring guests without a BINUS Square visitor card or who use a forged 
one will be considered an intrusion attempt. Boarders are prohibited from providing 
identification cards (BINUSIAN cards or temporary cards) to guests. 
▪ If visitors do not comply with the established rules, the Management has the right to 
ask the person concerned to leave the BINUS Square area. 
 
Sanctions 
I.  Summons, making a statement, and the room owner is subject to a fine. 
II.  Informed to the Boarder's parents. 
III.        The maximum penalty is expulsion from BINUS Square. 
 
3.2. SMOKING 
 
▪ The entire BINUS Square area is a smoke -free and e -cigarette- free area, including 
inside rooms, room balconies, bathrooms, and other public facilities, except the 
courtyard. 
▪ If you find cigarette butts or the smell of cigarettes in the corridor/room/ balcony, then 
the person concerned is considered to have violated the regulations. 
 
Sanctions 
I. Summons and making a statement. 
II. Boarder’s parents are informed that they cannot renew their stay at BINUS Square. 
III.  Expelled from BINUS Square.

3.3. LITTERING 
 
This category includes throwing/placing any form of trash/debris in the wrong place, 
causing the environment to be unclean, untidy, and/or smelly, throwing trash on the ground  
or floor/balcony, or leaving it in public areas/facilities. Boarders are required to be responsible 
for any damage or loss caused. 
 
Sanctions 
I.  Summons and making a statement. 
II.  A maximum social work sanction of 10 hours. 
III.   Expelled from BINUS Square. 
 
3.4. INAPPROPRIATE ACTIONS 
 
Unpleasant actions including incitement, threats, bullying, intimidation, slander , and 
defamation, including against the institution, employees, or other Boarders, whether in 
writing or not, directly or indirectly, such as electronic media, print media, or social media. 
 
Behavior that is considered inappropriate also includes: 
▪ Racially inappropriate: behavior that is harassing/ displeasing to others on the basis of 
race, religion, ethnicity, or politics. 
▪ Impropriety: verbal sentences in the form of swearing, cursing, or insults. 
 
Sanctions 
I.  Summons and making a statement. 
II.  Calling the Boarder’s parents. 
III.   Expulsion from BINUS Square. 
 
3.5. SHARP/DANGEROUS OBJECTS 
 
The distribution, sale, and possession of all types of firearms, sharp weapons (not used for 
cooking purposes), air guns/  replica firearms or dangerous equipment with the aim of 
endangering the safety of others and/or collections is prohibited in the BINUS Square area. 
 
Sanctions 
I.   Confiscation of goods, summons, and making a statement 
II.          Confiscation of goods and information to the Boarder’s parents. 
III.  Expulsion from BINUS Square.

3.6. ALCOHOL/ PSYCHOTROPICS/ OTHER ADDICTIVE SUBSTANCES 
 
▪ Alcohol and illegal drugs are substances that have a harmful impact on the health, 
safety, well-being, and academic achievement of Boarders. 
▪ Alcohol intended for worship (MISA) and owned only by the priest/pastor must be 
stored in the SSO. 
▪ The production, distribution, sale, purchase, storage, possession, and consumption of 
all types of alcoholic beverages (including used bottles of alcoholic beverages), 
psychotropic drugs, addictive substances, and dangerous drugs or other hard drugs 
without a doctor’s certificate are prohibited at BINUS Square. 
▪ Boarders who violate (drunk due to alcohol and/or  are under the influence of illegal 
drugs) will be subject to sanctions. 
▪ Boarders are required to comply when Management holds a drug test. 
 
Sanctions 
I.  Confiscation of goods, summons , and making a statement , e xcept for psychotropic 
drugs that are immediately removed from BINUS Square. 
II.          Confiscation of goods and information to the Boarder’s parents. 
III.  Expelled from BINUS Square. 
 
Cases of drug abuse can be subject to sanctions up to a maximum of being expelled as a BINUS 
University student, expelled from BINUS Square, and/or or handed over to the police. 
 
3.7. COOKING 
 
▪ Cooking activities must be carried out in the pantry area. 
▪ It is prohibited to use electricity in the corridor area of the room. 
▪ Boarders are required to use electric stoves ; anything other than electric stoves are 
not permitted. 
▪ The pantry area should be left clean. All cooking and eating utensils must be cleaned 
and put in their proper place. 
 
Sanctions 
I.   Confiscation of goods, summons, and making a statement. 
II.         Confiscation of goods and information to the Boarder’s parents. 
III.   Expulsion from BINUS Square.

3.8. VANDALISM AND/OR OR MISUSE OF FACILITIES AND INFRASTRUCTURE 
 
Vandalism is the act of damaging another person ’s property, including 
buildings/properties belonging to BINUS Square. Misuse of infrastructure is the act of using 
infrastructure that is not in accordance with its intended use or obstructing its function (for 
example, covering a smoke detector). All forms of vandalism and/or misuse of infrastructure 
will be subject to sanctions and replacement costs. 
 
Sanctions 
I. Summons and making a statement. 
II.          Informed to the Boarder’s parents. 
III.  Expulsion from BINUS Square. 
 
Items which are damaged still remain the property of the owner. Misuse of electrical facilities 
in public areas for electronic items other than those permitted by Management will result in 
confiscation and non-return of the items. The decision is final. 
 
Misuse of Internet facilities, such as pirating or attempting to pirat e, or any action that may 
cause disruption or damage to BINUS Square ’s Internet facilities, will result in Internet 
disconnection for 1 (one) to 6 (six) months. The decision is final. 
 
3.9. GAMBLING 
 
Gambling is any activity that uses money or goods as a wager on the outcome of a future 
match or event. All forms of gambling are strictly prohibited. Board members who engage in 
this activity are considered to be in violation. 
 
Sanctions 
I.  Summons, confiscation of evidence, and making a statement. 
II. Confiscation of evidence, and information to the Boarder’s parents. 
III. Expulsion from BINUS Square.

3.10. THEFT 
 
Theft is the act of taking another person's property without right or permission, with 
the intention of unlawfully controlling it. All forms of theft are strictly prohibited, including 
electricity theft. Those who commit this act are considered to be violating the law. 
 
Sanctions 
Expulsion from BINUS Square. 
 
3.11. VIOLENCE 
 
Violence is intentional and aggressive behavior that causes physical, psychological, or 
emotional harm to another person. This behavior can be physical, psychological, sexual, or 
even online. Any form of violence and disputes that cannot be resolved amicab ly will be 
referred to the authorities. Boarders who engage in these actions are considered to be in 
violation. 
Sanctions 
I.  Summons, amicable settlement, informed to the Boarder ’s parents , and making a 
written statement. 
II.         Expulsion from BINUS Square.  
 
3.12. ACTS OF HARMING YOURSELF 
 
Boarders and guests are prohibited from engaging in any form of self -harm, including 
but not limited to self-harm, jumping from heights, consuming dangerous substances without 
medical supervision, or other extreme actions that could endanger one’s life. All such actions 
are the Boarder ’s personal responsibility, and Management is not responsible for any 
consequences, including physical injury, psychological trauma, or other losses. These actions 
may result in administrative sanctions, mandatory counseling, and even termination of 
residency rights. Management reserves the right to take any necessary action or make any 
decisions. 
 
3.13. ACTS CONTRARY TO DECENCY 
 
Boarders are prohibited from engaging in any form of conduct that violates moral 
norms, including Public Display of Affection (PDA) such as hugging, kissing, or excessive 
physical contact that is not in accordance with general norms in the public areas of BINUS 
Square. Such actions are considered inappropriate and can disturb the comfort of other

Boarders. Violations of this provision will be subject to warnings, administrative sanctions, and 
even termination of the right to stay depending on the severity of the violation. For Boarders 
who engage in these actions in the BINUS Square area, they are violating the regulations. 
 
 
Sanctions 
I.  Verbal warning. 
II.          SSO summons and informs the Boarder’s parents. 
III.        Expulsion from BINUS Square. 
 
3.14. FRAUD 
 
Boarders are prohibited from committing any form of fraud, whether verbally or in 
writing, including but not limited to falsifying data, providing false information, manipulating 
documents, or other actions aimed at deceiving Management or fellow Boarders. Fraudulent 
acts are serious violations and may result in administrative sanctions, summoning 
parents/guardians (if necessary), termination of residency rights , and reporting to the 
authorities. Boarders who commit these acts are violating the regulations.  
 
Sanctions 
I.  Summons and making a statement. 
II.          Informed to the Boarder’s parents. 
III.   Expulsion from BINUS Square. 
 
3.15. PORNOGRAPHY 
 
Boarders are strictly prohibited from possessing, storing, distributing, or accessing 
pornographic content in any form, whether printed, digital, or through personal electronic 
devices, within the residential area. Any activity related to pornography is considered contrary 
to moral norms and can disrupt public order and comfort. Violations of this provision will be 
subject to strict sanctions, including written warnings, mandatory guidance, termination of 
residency rights, and reporting to the authorities i f necessary. Boarders who access or 
distribute pornographic material are considered to be violating the rules. 
 
Sanctions 
I.  Summons, inform the Boarder’s parents, and make a written statement. 
II.          Expulsion from BINUS Square.

3.16. NOISE 
 
Boarders are prohibited from causing noise or disturbances that could disturb the peace 
and comfort of other Boarders, especially during the applicable quiet hours, which are 9:00 
PM to 6:00 AM. Activities such as loud talking, playing music at a high volume, playing musical 
instruments, or other activities that produce excessive noise must be stopped during quiet 
hours. Violations of this provision will be subject to warnings, administrative sanctions, or 
disciplinary actions according to the severity of the violation. Those who violate this provision 
will be subject to sanctions. 
 
Sanctions 
I.   Verbal warning by the officer. 
II.          SSO summons and informs the Boarder’s parents. 
III.   Expulsion from BINUS Square. 
 
3.17. NON-COMPLIANCE IN FULFILLING FINANCIAL OBLIGATIONS 
 
Boarders are required to fulfill all financial obligations set by the management, including 
payment of rent, electricity, fines, or other applicable obligations. Delays, avoidance, or non-
compliance with payments may result in administrative sanctions, ser vice restrictions, and 
even termination of occupancy rights. The management reserves the right to take further 
action in accordance with the applicable regulations if a Boarder fails to fulfill his/her financial 
obligations. 
 
Sanctions 
BINUS Square Management reserves the right to take the following actions: 
▪ The Boarder is considered to have resigned from BINUS Square. 
▪ The room of the relevant Boarder can be given to another Boarder. 
▪ All items remaining in the room will be removed, secured for a certain period 
(maximum 2 weeks after the official notification letter is sent) , and will not be 
returned. These items will be destroyed or donated to a designated institution. 
 
The sanctions imposed do not eliminate the Boarder’s obligation to pay any outstanding rent 
or compensate for any damages. The amount of these costs will be determined by 
Management.

3.18. NON-COMPLIANCE IN FULFILLING THE MANAGEMENT’S SUMMONS 
 
Boarders are required to comply with all summonses from Management for guidance, 
clarification, or violation resolution. Absence without a clear and acceptable reason is 
considered a form of non -compliance. This action may result in administrative sanctions, 
written warnings, facility restrictions, or terminatio n of residency rights, depending on the 
severity of the violation. 
 
Sanctions 
I.  Warning and recording of violations in the logbook. 
II.  Informed to the Boarder’s parents. 
III.  Expulsion from BINUS Square. 
 
 
3.19. NOT COOPERATING/ HINDERING/ PREVENTING ACTIVITIES CARRIED OUT BY 
MANAGEMENT / EMERGENCY ACTIONS 
 
Boarders are required to cooperate, not hinder, or obstruct the implementation of 
management activities, including routine activities, inspections, outreach, and emergency 
measures such as evacuations, disaster management, or safety inspections. Uncooperati ve 
behavior or actions that disrupt these processes will result in administrative sanctions, 
warnings, and even termination of residency rights, depending on the severity of the violation 
and the risks involved. 
 
3.20. BRINGING/KEEPING ANIMALS 
 
Boarders are prohibited from bringing, keeping, or keeping pets of any kind within the 
BINUS Square area, either in their rooms or in public areas. This prohibition applies to all types 
of animals, including but not limited to cats, dogs, birds, reptiles, or other small animals. This 
measure aims to maintain the cleanliness, health, and comfort of all Boarders. Violations of 
this provision will result in administrative sanctions and the obligation to immediately remove 
the animal from the BINUS Square area.

3.21. ACCUMULATION OF VIOLATIONS 
 
Boarders who commit repeated violations or accumulate more than one type of 
violation will be subject to more severe sanctions. Accumulated violations, even if considered 
minor individually, can be considered moderate or serious if they occur continuously or over 
a period of time. Sanctions for accumulated violations can include coaching, written warnings, 
restricted access to facilities, or even termination of residency rights, in accordance with the 
applicable policies. 
 
4. BOARDER SUPPORT SERVICE 
 
4.1. BOARDER PORTAL   
 
The Boarder Portal is the official communication and information medium between 
Management and Board members. Every Boarder is required to always access the Boarder 
Portal for the latest information at square.apps.binus.ac.id/auth, accessible through 
BINUSMAYA, and the BINUS Square Mobile app can also be downloaded from Play Store and 
App Store. 
 
4.2. GAME EQUIPMENT 
 
▪ Game equipment is only for Boarders, event guests, and Guest Room guests, and can 
be borrowed through the Front Office. The equipment includes: carom, chess, table 
tennis rackets, darts, billiards (balls, triangle rack, and cues), balls (basketball, 
volleyball, and futsal), and cornhole. 
▪ Boarders are required to return the equipment in good condition. If the equipment is 
damaged, the borrower will be charged a replacement fee. The decision is final. 
 
4.3. LOST AND FOUND 
▪ Management is not responsible for searching for lost items. 
▪ For Boarders who lose or find items belonging to other boarders, please report to the 
Front Office. 
▪ Lost and found items will be kept for a maximum of 1 (one) month. After this period, 
the items will be destroyed. 
▪ For food items, they will be destroyed if not collected within 24 hours 
▪ Boarders can view a list of lost and found items on the Boarder Portal.

4.4. MAILS AND PACKAGES 
 
▪ Boarders will receive notifications of incoming mail or packages via the Boarder Portal 
/ BINUS Square Mobile. 
▪ Your full name, room number, and student ID number must be included on any mail 
or package. Mails or packages without clear and complete identification will be 
rejected and returned to the sender. 
▪ Mails or packages must be picked up no later than 1 (one) month after they are 
received. Packages containing food must be picked up no later than 3 (three) days after 
they are received. Mails and packages that are not picked up within this time period 
will be destroyed. 
 
4.5. FACILITY REPAIRS/ MAINTENANCE 
 
▪ If you need help repairing damage to equipment in the room, Boarders are required 
to report to the Estate Department via the Boarder Portal/BINUS Square 
Mobile/WhatsApp Estate. 
▪ Repairs will be carried out according to a previously announced schedule with or 
without the presence of the Board. If the Board is absent, repairs/ treatment will be 
carried out under the supervision of the staff on duty.  
▪ During the process, the Boarder is required to be responsible for oneself and one’s 
valuables.  
▪ If the damage is caused by the Boarder and costs arise for repairs/replacements, the 
Boarder is obliged to pay these costs. 
▪ Under certain conditions, BINUS Square Management will carry out MANDATORY 
facility maintenance and Boarders are requested to cooperate. Announcements 
regarding the maintenance schedule will be made in advance and if there is no 
response within 1 x 24 hours of the announcement, then the Boarder is deemed to 
have acknowledged and agreed to it. If the Boar der obstructs/does not cooperate 
according to the specified schedule, then the Boarder ’s room will be forcibly opened 
and the Boarder must compensate for any damage that may arise. 
▪ BINUS Square Management can do public area maintenance without an 
announcement. 
 
4.6. AC MAINTENANCE 
 
▪ Management will periodically perform maintenance on the air conditioning in the 
rooms. The schedule will be announced through the available information media 
(Boarder Portal / BINUS Square Mobile / WhatsApp Estate). 
▪ Boarders are required to store all their valuables properly. 
▪ Boarders are expected to be in the room during AC maintenance. If, according to the 
scheduled schedule, the Boarder is not in the room, then the Mechanical Engineering 
staff, under the supervision of the staff/security officer on duty, will make the 
necessary arrangements. They will still enter the room to do AC maintenance.

4.7. LOST KEYS (ROOM, CLOSET, BALCONY) 
 
▪ Boarders are not allowed to duplicate room keys. 
▪ Please contact the Front Office if you lose your room key. Management will replace the 
lost key cylinder with a new one. The replacement cost must be paid in full before you 
can receive a replacement key. 
 
5. ACCESS TO GENERAL FACILITIES 
Public facilities at BINUS Square are prioritized for boarders and guests staying at BINUS 
Square. From 1:00 AM to 5:00 AM, boarders are expected to remain quiet and refrain from 
activities in public areas. The main gate of BINUS Square will be closed from 11:00 PM. 
 
For Boarders who wish to leave the BINUS Square area, it is mandatory to: 
▪ Record your reason at the security post (after 2:00 PM). 
▪ Fill in the Leave Confirmation form via the Boarder Portal / BINUS Square Mobile (exit 
more than 1 x 24 hours). 
 
In terms of use of public areas and facilities: 
▪ All public areas are smoke-free and e-cigarette-free. 
▪ Maintain the cleanliness, tranquility, order, and comfort together. 
▪ Public Display of Affection (PDA) is prohibited in the public areas of BINUS Square to 
maintain norms of politeness, mutual comfort, and a conducive living atmosphere. 
▪ Behave and dress politely, including pay attention to the safety and comfort of other 
Boarders, visitors, guests, and staff. 
▪ Throw away rubbish in the rubbish bins provided. 
▪ Management has the right and authority to reprimand and/or ask Boarders, visitors , 
and guests to leave the public area and facilities if they do not comply with the existing 
rules. 
▪ Management is not responsible for any form of loss and/or damage that occurs in 
public areas and facilities, including accidents, injuries, death, or losses that occur in 
connection with the use of public areas and facilities. 
▪ Activities involving documentation of BINUS Square facilities and buildings require 
prior written permission from Management. Permission forms can be downloaded 
from the Boarder Portal / BINUS Square Mobile.

The lounge is intended as a place to socialize or meet visitors or fellow Boarders. 
▪ Lounge operating hours: 6:00 AM – 11:00 PM.  
▪ Only snacks and drinks are allowed to be consumed inside the Lounge.

5.2. CAFETERIA 
 
▪ Cafeteria operating hours: 6:30 AM - 9:00 PM.

▪ Reading Room operating hours: 6:00 AM - 11:00 PM, except during exam periods when 
it will be open 24 hours.

▪ Boarders are required to maintain calm.

▪ Swimming Pool operating hours: 6:00 AM - 9:00 PM.

▪ Please rinse your body before using the swimming pool. 
▪ Eating is prohibited in the area around the swimming pool. 
▪ It is prohibited to use the swimming pool if you are not well, suffering from a skin

medical treatment and care.

▪ Gym operating hours: 6:00 AM - 10:00 PM.

▪ Do not enter the gym area wearing sandals, high heels, or clothing that is not suitable 
for sports. 
▪ Keep your equipment clean and tidy. Always wipe it down after use and return it to its 
proper place. 
▪ It is prohibited to bring food and drinks (except water). 
▪ Use the equipment wisely and according to its intended function. Avoid overuse or 
damage to the equipment. 
▪ Do not engage in dangerous activities or disturb other users.

▪ The Changing Room is only for Boarders and guests staying at BINUS Square.

▪ Please empty the locker and return the key after use. 
 
5.8. COURTYARD 
 
The c ourtyard is open daily from 6:00 AM - 12:00 PM . This is the only designated 
smoking area in BINUS Square. Boarders are required to maintain the quiet and cleanliness 
of this area. Cigarette butts and trash must be disposed of in the provided bins.

There is a 24 -hour ATM (cash) machine available at the entrance gate of the BINUS Square 
complex.

5.10. INTERNET 
 
Internet facilities are intended for Boarders staying at BINUS Square.  
▪ Internet speed up to 1.5 Mbps (download and upload). 
▪ Internet facilities are provided to support the learning process and for communication 
between the Board and Management. Use of the Internet for other purposes is not 
permitted. 
▪ Boarders can access the Internet via LAN and Wi-Fi in their rooms. The Reading Room, 
Lounge, Cafeteria, Game Room, and Lobby are accessible via Wi-Fi. 
▪ Boarders are prohibited from committing Internet crimes that could disturb or harm 
other parties. 
▪ For Boarders who are found to be using devices that are considered to be disrupting 
BINUS Square’s internet, the Boarder will be subject to sanctions. 
▪ Sanctions in the form of compensation costs, the amount of which will be determined 
by Management, will be imposed if damage occurs to the modem in the room due to 
negligence on the part of the Boarder. 
 
5.11. LAUNDRY 
 
A laundry service by the kilo is available for Boarders. With the availability of laundry by 
the kilo, boarders are not permitted to dry clothes on the balcony or outside their rooms. 
▪ A m aximum quota of 21 kg/ person/ month, with a capacity for each wash of a 
maximum of 4 (four) kg. 
▪ Any unused quota remaining from the previous month can be carried over to the next 
month. This accumulation is valid from January 1 to December 31 of the same year. 
▪ If the weight of the laundry is less than 4 (four) kg, the recording will still be carried 
out at the maximum weight, namely 4 (four) kg and multiples thereof will apply. 
▪ Boarders are required to pay if they exceed the specified laundry quota usage. 
Payment is made directly to the vendor. 
▪ Laundry operating hours are Wednesday to Monday at 10:00  AM - 8:00 PM (pickup 
and delivery), Tuesday and national holidays are not operational. 
▪ Women’s clothing delivery schedule: Thursday, Saturday, Monday. 
Men’s clothing delivery schedule: Wednesday, Friday, Sunday. 
▪ Washing time is 3 (three) days. 
▪ Boarders are advised to separate delicate and easily faded clothing to avoid damage. 
▪ See the attachment for detailed information on the vendor’s laundry requirements.

facility.

application.

Boarders are responsible for the cleanliness of public facilities such as bathrooms, 
pantries, and corridors. For the comfort of all, upon completion of use, ensure the area is left 
clean and ready for use by other Boarders. If any items are found out of place or in an unclean 
condition, Management reserves the right to confiscate them and they will not be returned.

BINUS Square strives to provide security to all Boarders. 
▪ Security staff are on duty 24 hours a day and CCTV operates 24 hours a day to maximize 
surveillance throughout the BINUS Square area. 
▪ Lock the doors and windows, especially when leaving the room and keep the keys safe, 
and never leave the room open/ unlocked. 
▪ Access to enter every building and public facility in BINUS Square can only be done 
using a BINUSIAN card. 
▪ Take good care of your BINUSIAN card because it is an official identification card that 
shows your Boarder identity. 
▪ To avoid misuse of the BINUSIAN card, please immediately report it to Management if

6. BOARD ENGAGEMENT AND DEVELOPMENT 
 
The BINUS Square Student Support Office (SSO) is a student center under the supervision 
of the Vice Rector of Student Affairs at BINUS University. It is located in BINUS Square. The 
SSO offers various self-development programs for Boarders, including: 
▪ International Experience 
▪ Social Experience 
▪ Academic Development 
▪ Well-Being Program 
▪ Personal Development 
▪ BINUS Square Scholarship (Floor Coordinator, Academic Ambassador, BSSC Senior 
Committee, and Housing Coordinator) 
▪ BSSC (BINUS Square Student Committee) 
▪ Housing Program (House of Scientia, House of Clipa, and House of Ventura) 
 
6.1. STUDENT ORGANIZATIONS AND SCHOLARSHIPS FOR BINUS SQUARE BOARDERS 
 
6.1.1 BINUS SQUARE STUDENT COMMITTEE (BSSC) 
 
The BINUS Square Student Committee (BSSC) is one of the BINUS University Student 
Affairs Organizations especially for Boarders (BINUS University students who live in BINUS 
Square). Under the guidance o f the BINUS Square Student Involvement Center (SIC) and 
Student Support Office (SSO), the Student Affairs Organization which has been in existence 
since 2010 aim s to develop the soft skills  of boarders, both in the areas of leadership, 
teamwork, planning & organization, as well as give Boarders the chance to channel their 
ideas and interests as well as the talents they possess.  
 
BSSC has several divisions with different focus areas. Board members can join the 
divisions that best suit their interests. Each division is required to implement a collaborative 
work program for the first year of the BSSC administration. 
Some of the routine programs or activities held by BSSC at BINUS Square include: 
▪ BSSC Wonder 
▪ Culture Share with exchange students 
▪ BSSC Festival 
▪ Earth Hour 
▪ Square Olympics 
▪ Language Class (Korean, Japanese, Thai, French, German, etc.) 
▪ Music Class 
▪ BSSC Gathering 
▪ SHINE (Share Happiness, Inspiration, and Education)

6.1.2 BINUS SQUARE SCHOLARSHIP RECIPIENTS 
 
Boarders have the chance to become recipients of the BINUS Square Ambassador 
(BSA) Scholarship with the role of a Floor Coordinator, Academic Ambassador, BSSC Senior 
Committee, and Housing Coordinator with duties and responsibilities that are in accordance 
with its respective roles. To become a BINUS Square Ambassador, boarders will follow a 
series of selection processes held by the Student Support Office. By joining as a BINUS Square 
Ambassador, among other things, Boarders have the chance to develop various soft skills, 
such as leadership, teamwork, time management, etc. , under the guidance of the Student 
Support Offi ce. Additionally, board members who join the BINUS Square Ambassador 
program will receive a scholarship in the form of a discount on living expenses at BINUS 
Square. Before serving as a BINUS Square Ambassador, each role will receive various training 
to help them prepare for their duties. 
 
6.1.2.A. FLOOR COORDINATOR 
 
The Floor Coordinator is actively responsible for the well -being of the Boarders and 
coordinating other Boarders by inviting them to actively participate in activities, familiarizing 
fellow Boarders on the floor they coordinate, reminding them of the rules , and helping the 
BINUS Square MOD team when a boarder is sick. 
 
6.1.2.B. ACADEMIC AMBASSADOR 
 
Academic Ambassadors are responsible for regularly mentoring one or more study 
groups (minimum 8 meetings) within their respective majors for one semester. With this 
regular mentoring, participating board members are expected to be helped achieve their 
desired academic achievements. 
 
6.1.2.C. BSSC SENIOR COMMITTEE 
 
The BSSC Senior Committee is a scholarship awarded only to BSSC members who 
continue their membership to the next Presidency/term. Scholarship recipients must be 
active in the BSSC organization, participating and collaborating in activities held by SSO & 
other BINUS Square Ambassadors.

6.1.2.D. HOUSING COORDINATOR 
 
The Housing Coordinator is one of the scholarships provided for BINUS Square Boarders 
who play a role in advancing the housing program. In line with BINUS Square ’s tagline of “A 
Center for Creativity and Leadership ”, through this scholarship program BINUS Square 
Ambassador Housing participants can develop their creativity in making interesting and 
appropriate activities  as needed from its members. Not only that, BINUS Square 
Ambassadors can also develop aspects of their leadership by coordinating with the housing 
members to be actively involved in various housing program activities. 
 
6.2. ACTIVITY 
 
Organizational activities and programs held at BINUS Square are equal and recognized 
and have the same SAT (Student Activity Transcript) point weight as activities on the BINUS 
University campus. In addition, each activity organized by SSO also has activit y points that 
can be viewed through the level on the Boarder Portal / BINUS Square Mobile, which will be 
one of the considerations in determining the nominees for the Appreciation Night activity 
held by BINUS Square. Every boarder activity point collected can be exchanged for attractive 
BINUS Square merchandise. 
 
Boarders are urged to take part in every activity held at BINUS Square to improve their 
basic competencies, personal skills, social networks, and leadership skills as an effort to fulfill 
BINUS University’s BINUS Graduate Attributes (BGAs). 
 
In addition, BINUS Square SSO provides the opportunity to design and implement “From 
Boarder to Boarder ” activities, and it is hoped that the benefits will be felt by both the 
Boarders who organize the activities and the participants. To support this, we have a Housing 
Program where Boarders can choose one of three programs offered outside of their majors, 
namely:

Intended for Boarders who want to gain knowledge and develop new skills, especially in the 
fields of arts and culture according to their interests. 
 
•  HOUSE OF SCIENTIA 
Intended for Boarders who want to gain knowledge and develop new skills according to their 
interests in the field of innovation and technology.

•  HOUSE OF VENTURA 
Intended for Boarders who want to gain knowledge and develop new skills in the field of 
business and entrepreneurship that align with their interests. 
 
7. EMERGENCY AND EVACUATION 
 
7.1. MANAGER ON DUTY 
 
The BINUS Square Manager on Duty (MOD) is assigned employees  to alternate. To 
ensure smoothness in daily operational activities, it includes giving help quickly and 
precisely to Boarders who experience emergency health conditions. MOD is responsible 
for coordinating actions beginning with if there are Boarders who are sick, such as 
assisting in the evacuation process, accompanying them to the hospital, and ensuring 
Boarders get medical treatment in accordance with the applicable procedures.  In 
addition, the MOD will quickly inform the condition of the sick Boarder to the parents or 
registered guardian, so that the family can know and take necessary steps. 
The MOD assignment is done in turns by employees who are on standby 24 hours. 
With the MOD, it is hoped that Boarders will feel more safe and comfortable liv ing in 
BINUS Square, because emergency health needs will be handled in a professional and 
humanistic way.  
 
7.2. EVACUATION 
 
▪ Understand your position and the nearest emergency staircase evacuation route. 
▪ Corridors and emergency stairs should have unobstructed evacuation routes. 
▪ Boarders are expected to keep the corridors tidy by putting their shoes/ sandals on the 
shoe racks. 
▪ Management has the right to confiscate shoes/ sandals scattered without a shoe rack. 
▪ Do not place other objects such as trash cans, cleaning equipment, toiletries, towel 
racks, and items that interfere with corridor evacuation access. 
▪ It is prohibited to use the emergency stairs except in an emergency. 
 
At least once a year, BINUS Square Management will hold an evacuation drill. All Boarders are 
required to participate in this drill. 
 
General evacuation procedures: 
▪ When you hear the alarm sound, DON’T PANIC ; turn off all electronic devices that are 
on in the room. 
▪ Lock the room and immediately go to the emergency stairs to evacuate to the 
designated gathering point (Muster Point). 
▪ Walk quickly and DO NOT USE THE LIFT. 
▪ Remain gathered at the muster point and wait for further instructions from the 
officers.

9. GLOSSARY OF TERMS 
 
BINUS Square Management - All divisions within BINUS Square that manage operational 
activities for the comfort of residents. These divisions include General Operations, Estate, 
Finance, Program Development Center, and Marketing. 
 
MOD (Manager on Duty) - Assigned employee that takes turns to ensure smoothness in daily 
operational activities, handling urgent boarder needs, as well as acting quickly in emergency 
situations, such as helping a sick Boarder or those who need to be taken to the hospital.  
 
Boarder - The term for residents of the BINUS Square dormitory and also registered as active 
Binusians. 
 
Front Office - Staff who will be on duty 24 hours as an information center.

Guest room - A room provided for parents, university guests, and corporate guests. 
 
Binus Maya - Information media for BINUS University students. 
 
Boarder Portal – Information media for active Boarders living in BINUS Square. 
 
Checklist - Room handover process between BINUS Square and residents and vice versa. 
 
Residence hall - The building where Boarders live consists of hall A, hall B, hall C, and hall D. 
 
MCB (Miniature Circuit Breaker): Circuit breaker electricity current that has automatic 
functioning to protect the electricity installation from short-circuiting.  
 
Sprinkler - A fire extinguisher located in the ceiling of the room. 
 
Kwh - Kilowatt hours. 
 
BSSC - A student organization at BINUS Square that is recognized by BINUS University as a 
student activity unit. 
 
B. PENTHOUSE DORMITORY 
 
There is a s pecial Penthouse Dormitory intended for Boarders who have registered and 
have the right to live on the penthouse floor. The whole facilities available in the penthouse 
area may only be used by Boarder residents of this floor. Penthouse boarders are prohibited 
from bringing or allowing other boarders who are not penthouse residents to use or access 
penthouse facilities, in order to maintain the comfort, security, and exclusivity of the 
penthouse area. 
 
Facilities 
▪ Shared bathroom equipped with a water heater. 
▪ Shared pantry with an electric stove and refrigerator. 
▪ Single Premium: Bean bag, blanket, water gallon, and water dispenser. 
▪ Single Standard: Electric water pump. 
▪ Bed sheets with the size of 90 x 200 cm. 
▪ Study table, bookshelves, chairs, and cupboards. 
▪ Laundry service up to 21 kg per month and Internet access. 
▪ Penthouse lounge is equipped with a TV, board games, and snacks.

C. EXCLUSIVE DORMITORY 
The BINUS Square Exclusive Dormitory provides comfort, privacy, and premium service 
for Boarders who want to experience an exclusive stay. Each unit in the Exclusive Dormitory 
is equipped with more complete facilities compared to other types, so that it supports the 
academic, comfort, and modern lifestyle needs of the residents. 
The Exclusive Dormitory offers a quiet residential atmosphere with a limited number of 
residents and access to additional facilities that are not available for other types of room. 
With the various superiorities, this Exclusive Dormitory is the choice for Boarders who 
prioritize the best comfort and quality in a residence while undergoing their education at 
BINUS University. 
 
Facilities 
▪ The bathroom is equipped with a water heater. 
▪ A shared pantry with an electric stove, a food warmer, fully furnished, and a refrigerator. 
▪ Standard and Superior: bed sheets (120 x 200 cm), water gallon, and electric water pump. 
▪ Deluxe: Living room, bed sheets (180 x 200 cm or 80 x 200 cm), water gallon, and electric 
water pump. 
▪ Cleaning and floor mopping are done twice a week. 
▪ Study table, bookshelves, chairs, and cupboards.
